title: Official blog authoring brief stage 14
summary: This iteration adds an internal authoring brief for OpenAI and Anthropic official-blog review decisions. It turns accepted review decisions into human-completion templates, keeps needs_review customer or partnership stories in a manual-review bucket, carries deterministic field suggestions and related-blog hints, and avoids generating translations, summaries, curated records, or public artifacts.

lessons.lesson: Accepted AI review decisions still need a human authoring boundary before curated records are written.
lessons.evidence: Stage 14 produces `official_blog_authoring_brief` with `reviewed_entry_template` placeholders instead of completed Chinese authoring fields.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the authoring brief as the handoff to manual translation and synthesis, then pass completed reviewed entries into `official-blog:author-records`.

lessons.lesson: Manual-review items must stay visible but outside authoring templates.
lessons.evidence: The authoring brief maps Stage 13 `needs_manual_review` into `manual_review_required` and never creates a `reviewed_entry_template` for those items.
lessons.recommended_action: Read customer or partnership stories fully before promoting them into reviewed entries.

lessons.lesson: Relationship suggestions are useful as authoring hints, not automatic graph mutations.
lessons.evidence: Stage 14 can attach suggested related blog ids by normalized URL, but only inside `suggested_fields` and template placeholders.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep suggested related ids reviewable during authoring before they become public curated graph edges.

suggestions.issue: Accepted review decisions had no compact human handoff before the reviewed author-record stage.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 14 adds `createOfficialBlogAuthoringBrief` and `official-blog:authoring-brief`, plus tests for accepted-only authoring templates, manual-review preservation, clean JSON output, relationship suggestions, and public output guards.
suggestions.suggestion: Generate an internal authoring brief after AI review decisions and before manually completed curated records.
suggestions.expected_benefit: The official-blog workflow can move high-value product, model, and engineering posts toward translation and synthesis without auto-publishing AI decisions or borderline customer stories.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through pure function and CLI coverage, with public output guards and internal payload sanitization.
validation_evidence: official blog authoring brief creates human templates from accepted decisions only
official blog authoring-brief CLI writes clean internal authoring packet
official blog authoring-brief CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add an optional command that validates completed authoring brief templates before passing them to `official-blog:author-records`.
Add live official-blog discovery only after it writes preview feed, review packet, decision, and authoring-brief artifacts as separate internal steps.
